## Design

### 2026-10-10 – This was my first time dealing with a PCB designer. For the first 2 hours, I was learning how to use the software and was applying it simply to the Starbie Project I am doing. After that, I went about

**13h**

This was my first time dealing with a PCB designer. For the first 2 hours, I was learning how to use the software and was applying it simply to the Starbie Project I am doing. After that, I went about setting up the project. It took me a long time to make the schematic itself. After I finished the schematic, it took me a long time to download and add the footprint libraries. After that, I started editing the routing phase. At first, I made the star body shape. Then, I started adding the parts and fitting them in the star shape. Later, I started routing the connections between the different components, and I did it lots of times to reach the correct routing. After finishing the routing, I learned how to make a zone field. Finally, I made a DRC and corrected the errors I had.
